# goslop text fixture — health-check catch-all models unhealthy status
# after logging (logxide examples/* health endpoints audited FP).
# Uses "unhealthy" only — "degraded" alone must stay reportable
# (WeThePeople routers/common.py health TP).
lang: python
file: health.py
---
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def health_check(db):
    try:
        db.execute("SELECT 1")
        db_status = "healthy"
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error("Database health check failed: %s", e)
        db_status = "unhealthy"
    return {"status": "healthy" if db_status == "healthy" else "degraded", "database": db_status}
